_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later. FORK: CADApp construction rule sets (design doc §5.5, §12 R14). Advisory checks only. These are EXAMPLE values: they are not taken from any building code and do not show code compliance. Copy this item to your user library under a new id with the values adopted where you build, and have the design reviewed by your building official or a qualified professional.
source: Generic example values from conventional framing practice and engineering mechanics (beam bending and deflection; column slenderness l/d) the stair comfort rule 2 x riser + tread (F. Blondel, Cours d'architecture, 1675), and common woodworking practice (mortise walls, allowing solid wood to move across its grain, anchoring tall furniture against tipping); not copied from any code or standard

items.name: Generic example - verify for your jurisdiction
